name: Premier Electric Inc.
old_description: Premier Electric Inc. has always operated under strong values aimed at exceeding client needs. Our communication channels are always open—our relationship with our clients begins on the first day of contact, and only ends once they’re fully satisfied with our work.
about:
Premier Electric Inc. is an electrical contracting and solar installation firm based in Sheridan, Wyoming. The company was established in 2006 and has served Sheridan and Johnson counties since then. Ownership details and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides three core services: electrical contracting for residential, commercial, and industrial projects including installations, repairs, and maintenance; solar power system design and installation for homes, businesses, and agricultural operations; and automatic standby generator installation for backup power. It operates as a service provider rather than a manufacturer, with no reported facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

Premier Electric serves residential homeowners, commercial building owners, industrial facilities, and agricultural clients such as farms and ranches across northern Wyoming. Typical projects include new construction wiring, remodel work, solar array installations on ranches, and generator systems for emergency preparedness.

The company emphasizes personalized service, transparent pricing, and a commitment to quality workmanship and punctuality. Its founders aimed to build a relationship-driven business that maintains open communication from first contact through project completion.
